comparedVariants.v1: active Qwen legacy embedding plus current hybrid RRF
comparedVariants.B0: Qwen official retrieval v2 plus current hybrid RRF
comparedVariants.B2: B0 candidates plus local BGE reranker over Top-5

metricDefinitions.primaryPolicyAccuracyAt1: Top-1 chunk has graded relevance 3 for the primary risk.
metricDefinitions.ndcgAt3: Graded policy relevance 0-3 over the three citations consumed by workflow.
metricDefinitions.multiRiskCoverageAt3: For multi-risk cases, Top-3 qrels jointly support every annotated risk type.
metricDefinitions.candidateRecallAt5: At least one relevance-3 primary-policy chunk appears in Top-5.
metricDefinitions.reflectionAccuracy: Deterministic Reflection output equals expectedEvidenceStatus using annotated risks and Top-3 citations.
metricDefinitions.decisionAccuracy: Governance decision derived from annotated risk severity and Reflection equals expectedDecision.
metricDefinitions.highRiskPrimaryOmissionCount: High-risk cases without a relevance-3 primary-policy chunk in Top-3.
